title: Pausable, Gacha collection and Crafters
changelog: Added some minor ingame config changes
Added Pausable feature, when GBot run, hit ESC ingame or switch tabs to pause GBot.
If you want to Alt+Tab with Pause, disable [Allow focus ARK window] in Settings/Launcher.
Added Gacha collection feature(Settings/Gacha/Gacha Collection), you can now collect Gacha items such as Phoenix Silica, snail paste, etc.
Added Crafters feature(Settings/Craft), you can now craft items such as Polymer, can craft with multiple crafters.
Rework Autokey, now you can trigger faster with default F1+[key], support 'W' key.
Optimize Server Transfer, update its detection due to Steam changes.
